face.name: 鲜血魔术师
face.text: 战吼：消耗一份残骸， 发现一张鲜血符文牌。
face.flavorText: 就让她来帮你！重塑！形体！

face.name: Hematurge
face.text: Battlecry: Spend a Corpse to Discover a Blood Rune card.
face.flavorText: She's here to PUMP! YOU UP!

face.name: 死灵殡葬师
face.text: 战吼：如果在你的上回合之后有友方亡灵死亡，发现一张邪恶符文牌。
face.flavorText: 头衔里带一个师字，头发里全都是虱子。

face.name: Necrotic Mortician
face.text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, Discover an Unholy Rune card.
face.flavorText: Her hair, just like her name, is full of 'tic's.

face.name: 冰霜打击
face.text: 对一个随从造成 3点伤害。如果该随从死亡，发现一张冰霜符文牌。
face.flavorText: 有人要打球吗？霜打！

face.name: Frost Strike
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, Discover a Frost Rune card.
face.flavorText: Anyone up for some frost bowling?

face.name: 格斗士
face.flavorText: 他们的血液里充斥着尚武精神，想要打一架吗？

face.name: Pit Fighter
face.flavorText: What did the pits ever do to you?

face.name: 熟练的水手
face.flavorText: 他喜欢在船上颠簸的感觉，比在陆地上走路更有安全感。

face.name: Salty Dog
face.flavorText: He's recently recovered from being a "scurvy dog."

face.name: 藏宝海湾保镖
face.flavorText: 你可以雇佣他们为你效命...直到有人出更高的价钱来让他们对付你。

face.name: Booty Bay Bodyguard
face.flavorText: You can hire him... until someone offers him enough gold to turn on you.

face.name: 白银之手骑士
face.flavorText: 做一名骑士很威风，但是做骑士的侍从感觉就差一点了。

face.name: Silver Hand Knight
face.flavorText: It's good to be a knight. Less so to be one's squire.

face.name: 盾甲侍女
face.flavorText: 对于侏儒战士来说，一块盾牌可以对其进行全方位的保护。

face.name: Shieldmaiden
face.flavorText: She has three shieldbearers in her party to supply her with back ups when she gets low on durability.

face.name: 老式治疗机器人
face.text: 战吼：为你的英雄恢复 8点生命值。
face.flavorText: 由于可能会因为爆炸而影响患者的治疗，这种类型的机器人已经停产很久了。

face.name: Antique Healbot
face.flavorText: They don't make 'em like they used to! (Because of explosions, mostly.)

face.name: 夜刃刺客
face.text: 战吼：对敌方英雄造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 你的脸可能是你最不希望被刀子碰到的地方，但却是潜行者们最喜欢下手的地方。

face.name: Nightblade
face.flavorText: Your face is the place you'd probably least like a dagger, and where rogues are most likely to deliver them.

face.name: 雷矛特种兵
face.flavorText: 雷矛特种兵都是爆破专家。他们还会烘焙简易的蛋糕。

face.name: Stormpike Commando
face.flavorText: The Stormpike Commandos are demolition experts. They also bake a mean cupcake.

face.name: 消散的回忆
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（5）的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 我想到了一条绝妙的卡牌趣文……怎么又忘了？

face.name: Fading Memory
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.
face.flavorText: I had the best idea for flavor text! …what was it again?

face.name: 荆棘谷猛虎
face.flavorText: 这些美丽的大猫是荆棘谷一道亮丽的风景！

face.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
face.flavorText: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!

policies.scope: Three newly executable Standard candidate Rune roots, eight necessary older printed5-cost collectible candidate dependencies and one exact2/2Squire. No Wild-format deliverable, complete past pool or implemented-only filter is added. Existing current Tiger family remains byte-exact and old EX1_028 is not counted.
policies.hematurge: Actual Battlecry always submits native SpendResource(CORPSES,1), without a snapshot precheck. The execution-time bank chooses exactly one native branch; only successful payment runs ordinary collectible Blood Rune discovery. Corpus payment, choice, rollback and original captured player stay shared.
policies.mortician: Read the actual last closed owner interval, not globalturn-2. DeathQuery starts at the first global turn after that exact owner interval; before any previous owner interval it covers recorded game history. End-of-that-owner-turn deaths remain inside the closed turn and do not qualify. Every friendly original death in the real window is checked through public has_any_tribe on its frozen DeathRecord enchantments, including ALL/exclusions/current tribe. Unknown facts fail, no current entity reconstruction or shadow clock.
policies.strike: Original3Spell damage with actual health-result callback. InvokeHealthResult re-enters fresh state and existing direct_death matches the exact original target and complete damage/poison cause payload. Only its actual original linked death yields collectible Frost Rune discovery. Earlier same-ID deaths, surviving/redirected/reaction-destroyed targets are not inferred kills; actual Reborn after the original death does not revoke the original reward.
policies.runes: Use positive printed blood/unholy/frost Rune requirements through PoolQuery.runes_any, independent of spell school, current hero class and deck Rune allocation. Ordinary full candidate validation, discovery policy and private choice/delivery are retained; no local source-specific restricted pool.
policies.basics: Pit Fighter5/6 and Salty Dog7/4 have their exact blank printed text; Booty Bay Bodyguard5/4 has native Taunt. Silver Hand Knight submits one attributed ordinary Squire summon. Shieldmaiden gains5Armor, Antique Healbot heals the accepted player hero8 through ordinary EFFECT healing, Nightblade deals3MINION_ABILITY damage to the accepted enemy hero, Stormpike Commando deals2MINION_ABILITY damage to its ordinary required character target. No Battlecry is moved into generic on_play.
policies.family: Known canonical existing Standard family metadata is checked separately from raw record identity. Raw-only first audit did not inherit the existing CORE_EX1_028 canonical identity and is retained; second audit uses exact current definitions. This does not certify all possible alias equivalences or exact past eligibility.
policies.evidence: Complete original rows and full primary bodies/receipts stay fixed. Only the accepted exact Hematurge proxy macro is explicitly omitted. No printed scalar default is assumed; all selected minion costs/Attack/Health are explicit and strictly compared.
policies.limits: Accurate CN pool eligibility, before-first-own-turn policy, death/tribe and payment/health/discovery timing remain internal policies pendingM6. M0 formal legal pool and all actual reachable content stay open.
